description.value: Britannia Brewing Lake Country is a craft brewery restaurant and bar set on a 10,000 sq ft facility in the Okanagan, near the popular Okanagan Rail Trail cycling corridor. Established in 2014 and expanded from its Steveston and Ladner origins, it offers a full menu of house ales alongside locally inspired dishes featuring Okanagan ingredients like peaches and BC mushrooms. The 200-seat restaurant with outdoor picnic area makes it a substantial stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan Valley.

address.value: 8999 Jim Bailey Road, Kelowna BC, V4V 1S4
